During bombing raids your escorting or intercepting fighters now hit on a “1” or “2” instead of just a “1”.

Major industrial complexes can mobilize up to 12 units, and minor one scan mobilize up to 4 units. Also, when repairing a damaged industrial complex, you can remove 2 damage markers for the cost of 1 IPC (in other words, half price). The maximum damage that can be applied to your industrial complexes is not increased.

Description: Capital ignores first 2 SBR damage.

Description: Oil derricks/platforms: require 2 bombing hits to disable, repair cost reduced by 1 IPC.

Optional OIL: Oil derrick/platform cost reduced by 1 IPC

Name: War Economy Planning
Description: May convert 1 captured Industrial Complex to operational next turn (also major Industrial Complexes).

Name: Advanced Fuel Efficiency
Description: Oil costs reduced by 50% (round up) for: Land OR air (choose each turn)

Name: Strategic Fuel Reserves
Description: Oil storage cap = +10. Pay 2 IPC per needed oil: Ignore all oil penalties.

Name: Armoured Trains
Description: Railway sections have AAA.

Name: Industrial Mobilization
Description: Industrial Complexes produce +1 unit.

Name: Improved Shipyards
Description:
Your sea units are now cheaper to build. Use these revised costs:  Unit | IPC cost , Battleship | 17, Aircraft Carrier | 13, Cruiser | 9, Destroyer | 7, Transport | 6, Submarine | 5
Optional OIL: first naval action costs no oil this turn.

Name: Mobile factories
Description: Minor Industrial Complexes can move 1 space during movement phase

Name: Industrial Expansion
Description: Capitol territories now have room for 5 facilities in stead of 4. Normal territories now have room for IPC-value + 1 facilities. Maximum for non-capitol territories stays 3.

Name: Express Railway
Description: Units may move over interconnected railways in friendly territory as if it is one move (also leading to attack).
Flavour text: Railway may be bought during P&R Phase

Name: Megafactories
Description: You can buy mega-factories that have no limit on placing new units (when without damage) and produce 1 free unit per turn.

Name: Advanced Assembly Lines
Description: May build one extra free fighter per turn.

Name: Germany: Enigma
Description: Germany: While enigma is active, every turn in every first battle with every different enemy it attacks Germany has a surprise first combat round i,e, the round cannot be defended and casualties are removed from the board without firing back, similar to Submarines’ Surprise Attack.

Name: Basic Espionage
Description: Once per turn, peek at one opponent’s IPC total before purchases.

Name: Codebreaking
Description: Once per turn force opponent to reroll one battle round.

Name: Propaganda Campaign
Description: At the end of the turn place influence marker in neutral territory (for 4 IPC or move 1 landunit in this territory and dissolve unit) and move alignment from neutral to your side on your next turn only if you have the most influence markers (enemy aligned = strict neutral => allied aligned) This will not turn Mongolian Neutrals in Russian army troops.

Name: UK: Alan Turing
Description: In order to use Enigma for every battle throw a d6 to determine if enigma is working by rolling a 1.

Name: Cryptographic Systems
Description: Surprise attack on sea battle, one battle per turn in total. Same as submarine, but for whole fleet and not defendable by destroyers.

Name: Propaganda Effect on Mobilization
Description: +1 Infantry every Purchase & Repair Phase (or depending on the amount of territories OCCUPIED)

Name: Camouflage
Description: In one battle this turn, when defending with Land Units, they may have one surprise attack at the beginning of combat.

Name: Intelligence Directorate
Description: Enables development of various intelligence activities

Name: Espionage Networks
Description: Sabotage an Industrial Complex on 1–2 once per turn. Then roll d6 for damage.

Name: Signals Interception
Description: Reduce one enemy’s air movement by 1 once per turn. Declare during your own mobilization phase.

Name: Stealth Techniques
Description: Disables Enemy Radar capabilities this round for 1 enemy at cost of 2 IPC

Name: Resistance Coordination
Description: Spawn 1 partisan in occupied original territory (once per turn). Join fight as infantry as soon as territory is attcked / fight on their own.

Name: Counterintelligence
Description: Ignore one successful sabotage attempt.

Name: Scientific Espionage
Description: Opponent of choice must reveal one research choice. On 1 for a d6 roll cancel this research. The party spying may or may not keep this information private.

Name: Political Influence Operations
Description: Where applicable reduce Intelligence actions cost by 1 IPC

Name: Mustering locals
Description: In every non-original territory that you occupy get 1 infantry during Mobilization Phase

Name: Counter sabotage
Description: Cancel one existing tech of your choice from an enemy for XX IPC and a 1 on a d6 roll.
Flavour text: We go in. We get what we want. We come out.

Description: Steal tech from an enemy for 2  IPC and a 1 on a d6 roll (only tech that you are enabled for)

Name: Sabotage
Description: Damage 1 facility or base for 2 IPC this turn. Then roll d6 for damage.

Name: Reduced Bombing effect
Description:
Strategic bombing damage reduced by 50% (round down).
Optional OIL: Oil facilities take no damage on rolls of 1–2.

Name: Morale Systems
Description: Once per turn, one land battle may ignore the first casualty taken.

Name: Barbed wire
Description: Infantry movement penalty. Cost is 1 IPC.

Name: Entrenchment Doctrine
Description: Last infantry defending in original territories may absorb 1 extra hit before removal.

Name: Barracks
Description: Produce regular infantry (not specialized units) at the cost of 3 IPP.

Description: Tanks may blitz through 1 additional territory if unoccupied.

Name: Czech hedgehogs
Description: Tanks movement penalty -1

Flavour text: Small reliability boost. No raw stat change.

Description: Cost 3 IPC, defend 2 times @ 2 before first round of battle against Land units but tanks, will be removed when it hits, changes owner in case territory is captured and survives battle. In case of multiple: roll all at once and distribute hits over land mines in any way: 2 hits on a 4 die roll can be appointed to one and the same land mine.

Name: Tank Destroyers
Description: Will attack @ 3 before first round of combat directed at tanks. Every tanks destroyed this way will de removed from battlefield. After that Tank destroyers count as default Mech. Inf.

Name: Urban Warfare Training
Description: Infantry defend at +1 in cities/VC territories.

Name: Field hospital
Description: By a 1 by D6 infantry casualty return to nearest field hospital and “respawn” there (but cannot participate in movement phase). If two Field hospitals are at the same distance: owner chooses.

Name: Land Warfare Research Center
Description: Enables Research for Land Units and Bunkers

Name: Bunkers
Description: Absorbs 1 hit every round in battle as long as at least one land unit present. Can be destroyed by 5 damage from (tactical) bombing.

Description: Mechanized Infantry and Infantry may move +1

Description: Each of your artillery units can now provide greater support. One artillery unit can support up to 2 infantry and/or mechanized infantry units per attack. Up to 2 infantry and/or mechanized infantry units when coupled with 1 artillery unit have attack values of 2.

Name: Concrete bunkers
Description: Every round attacker must sacrifice one land unit

Name: Enforced bunkers

Description: Artillery may Blitz and move +1 (like tanks) and support up to two Infantry

Name: Improved Artillery

Description: Each of your mechanized infantry units that is paired up with a tank or an artillery now has an attack value of 2. Also, your mechanized infantry may now blitz.

Name: Marines

Name: Nuclear bunkers
Description: Infantry present will survive nuclear apocalypse.

Name: Artillery Fire Control

Description: All tanks now attack +1

Name: Commandos
Description: Can be dropped in enemy territories behind enemy lines and occupy territory, need to be dropped by transport planes or tactical bombers capable of dropping paratroopers.

Description: Transport may carry two land units of ANY choice

Name: Jet Propulsion
Description: Cruisers may move +2

Name: Advanced Submarine Hulls
Description: Submarines defend at 2 instead of 1.

Name: Advanced ASW
Description: Destroyers hit submarines on 1–2.

Name: Torpedos
Description: Capital ships can defend against Suprise Strikes from submarines, the same way destroyers can.

Name: Gatekeeper systems

Description: Enables Research for Sea Units and Ports

Name: Submarine Fleet Coordination

Description: All surface ships may move +1 (Transport, Destroyer, Cruiser, Carrier, Battleship)
Unit: Transport, Destroyers, Cruisers, Aircraft Carrier, Battleship

Description: In sea zones w/ enemy naval ports, submarines loose special abilities like there is a destroyer present.

Name: Armed transports

Description: Submarines can submerge after suprise attack

Name: Silent Running

Name: Heavy carriers
Description: Carriers can attack and defend +1.

Name: Germany: Occultism: The Ahnenerbe Institute

Name: Germany: Occultism: Expedition to Tibet
Description: Occupy Tibet to obtain the ability: for 1 Vril energy token ignore one research dependency OR reduce research cost by 1 IPC.

Name: Germany: Occultism: Thule Society
Description: You now have developed the Hannebeau II Saucer. For 1 Vril token the UFO can move 1 infantry from one place to another (if the territory is enemy occupied, the infantry unit is in combat) OR you may move one enemy aircraft back to it’s place of origin.

Name: Germany: Occultism: Spear of Longinus
Description: Using the Spear of Destiny: for 1 Vril token once per turn you may determine the outcome of one die roll yourself.

Name: Fighter Jets
Description: Fighters defend at 5 and move +1.

Name: Germany: Atlantik Wall
Description: When there are bunkers in Normandy, Netherlands, Danmark and Norway those territories cannot be the target of Amphibious Assault, although starting combat from sea is still possible.

Name: Germany: Wunderwaffen: LandKreuzer P. 1500
Description: Super Heavy Armor: Landkreuzer P. 1500 Monster: attacks at 5 A5D5M2C14

Name: Germany: Occultism: Die Glocke
Description: Once per round you can reset the turn of a power (self, enemy or ally). That turn starts all over.

Name: Japan: Kido Butai Doctrine
Description: Production of one extra ship every turn (including Capital Ships).

Name: Project Manhattan – Development
Description: Develop and Test Atomic Bomb: Pick one of your original territories and place two radiation tokens on it. Remove one every consecutive turn, as long as there are tokens, the IPC count is 1 IPC and max unit count is limited to infantry. You may move them during movement phase to neighboring territories. Additional to the Research cost pay 1 uranium resource and 2 heavy water.

Name: Russia: Deep Battle Doctrine
Description: (Mechanized) Infantry may move +1 and may move after combat if territory cleared.

Name: Rail Super Gun -  Schwerer Gustav
Description: The armoured train artillry. Can move to all rail connected sections in one move and participate in combat 2 territories away. Stays in combat until all friendly land units are out of combat.  Can only be targeted by bombings (like a facility without AAA) A3/Dx/M1/C?

Name: The Wolfpack: Super Submarines
Description: The attack value of your submarines is now 3 instead of 2.

Name: UK: Global Intelligence Network
Description: Spy spawns in capital (A0/D0/M2/C8) and is able to sabotage facilities, steal or cancel tech (while in enemy capital) or cancel one battle this round from the power it is currently residing (play as interrupt in enemy’s combat phase, while not having performed one of your earlier options this round.

Name: US: Industrial capacity
Description: Get 1 unit for free during your mobilization phase from any Cluster (Air, Land, Navel) you have researched reaching tier 6.

Name: Fighter Jets
Description: Fighters attack at 5 and move +1

Name: Germany: Atlantic Wall Pt. 2
Description: For all coastal territories with bunkers the enemy’s Amphibious Assault is disabled when attacking this territory.

Name: Germany: Wunderwaffen: LandKreuzer P. 1500
Description: Super Heavy ArmorLandkreuzer P. 1500 Monster now can absord 2 hits

Name: Germany: Occultism: Die Glocke
Description: Once per round you can reset the turn of a power (self, enemy or ally). That turn is cancelled.

Name: Japan: Kido Butai Doctrine
Description: Carriers can stand 3 hits, where 1 hits has no functional impact, may carry +1 aircraft and can participate in Amphibious Assaults.

Name: Project Manhattan – Production
Description: Able to produce the Atomic Bomb (you need transportation to deliver this) Dropping the Bomb: Atomic attack on a 1-4 d6 roll permanently destroys  all units and maximizes damage on facilities in territory (one-use weapon) and reduces production value of territory to 1 IPC for the duration of 5 years. Place radiation markers (10) in territory accordingly, remove one every round.  Must need a delivery system (nuclear sub, flying fortres or rocket) to use.

Name: Russia: Deep Battle Doctrine
Description: Every major Industrial Complex creates one (Mechanized) Infantry during mobilization phase.

Name: Rail Super Gun – Langer Gustav
Description: Can combat 4 spaces away, hits +1  and has AAA that hits on +1

Name: The Wolfpack: Suprise Tactics
Description: If the number of submarines in a seazone outnumbers the amount of destroyers, the ability to cancel submarine special features is canceled: submarines can perform Suprise Strike, Submerge and Can’t Be Hit By Air Units.

Name: UK: Global Intelligence Network
Description: If spy is present in enemy territory AND territory is attacked by self or an ally spawn 3 infantry to join the fight.

Name: US: Industrial powerhouse
Description: Land Units built in Industrial Complexes may be placed in adjacent territories you own and Airplanes may be placed in any naval port you own. Build limit per IC +2 AND Land units cost -1 IPC.

Name: Project Manhattan – Dropping The Bomb
Description: This is not an actual Research Item (and will not cost IPC’s), but more of a placeholder that all dependencies are met in order to deliver and drop the bomb on it’s destination.

Name: Oil
Description:
Oil acts as a second currency (like IPCs) BUT: it is mainly used for operations (movement/combat), not required to be transported, stored and spent nationally. Oil can be derived from oil producing territories via Oil Derricks or seazones via Oil Platform or by developing a Synthetic Oil Plant. Japan starts with 1 oil in the bank.
Oil costs: Land: 1 oil per major offensive Air: 1 oil per battle Naval: 1 oil per fleet per turn (+1 if combat).
Penalties (when out of oil): Tanks/mech → no blitz Aircraft → -1 attack Navy → cannot enter hostile zones.
Rules: Production From territories + infrastructure Collected during income phase Max storage: 15 (soft cap at 10, after 10 lose 1 oil each turn). )Convoys → lose IPC OR oil and Bombing → disables oil structures. Emergency Rule: Replace Oil cost by 3 times the amount in IPC.

Name: Aluminium
Description: Aluminium is produced in an Aluminium Factory and when transported to an industrial complex you get a discount of 2 IPC when building a Jet, Rocket or Flying Fortress.

Name: Steel
Description: Steel is produced in a Steel Factory and when transported to an industrial compllex you get a discount of 2 IPC when building a Super Submarine, Heavy Tank or Heavy Capital ship.

Name: Vril
Description: Vril energy acts as currency for the use of German Occult Artifacts (GOA) and are produced by the Ahnenerbe Institute one each turn.

Name: Uranium
Description: Resource mined from 1 of 5 fixed Uranium mines: Western United States, Slovakia, Belgian Congo, Yukon Territory. Cannot be build. Production is 1 per turn.

Name: Heavy Water
Description: Resource produced in a Heavy Water Plant: two exist at the start of the game: Norway, Ukraine. More can be build.

Name: University
Description: You are now able to build a university, which grants 1 Research Point per turn.
